scope: Official OGB ogbl-ddi definition/table and pinned NCNC/PENCIL DDI loader source scopes only; no leaderboard or full-paper read credit.
split: Protein-target split; test drug mechanisms differ from training/validation.
attributes: NCNC loader uses trainable node-ID embeddings; PENCIL explicitly disables supplied node features for DDI. These are family-specific representations, not matched learned capacity.
choice_rationale: A denser graph is a mechanistically different candidate for the count-conditioned neighbourhood-pattern auxiliary. Existing Collab TRAIN evidence has only1.3599% both-genuine supports. DDI is chosen for a prospective structural-support check, not a favourable score.
unresolved: Published whole-graph density does not measure actual TRAIN informative support under the native masking/candidate contract.
Full official TRAIN census must establish nondegenerate both-side supports and count DP resource cost before a predictive fit.
DDI protocol/feature handling and competent author recipe need a specific implementation binding.
Recent strong DDI baselines must be identified and actually qualified; a generic BatchEnsemble wrapper is not a methodological novelty.
decision: Retain as a next independent-confirmation candidate. Do not acquire/test or train solely from this scout; first bind selective TRAIN-only acquisition and native support census, preserving official heldout splits.
